sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; QVal ranked first after current-week and duplicate-risk screening.
Main agent read the arXiv PDF/HTML plus official project and repository docs, extracting methods, metrics, figures, environment setup, and limitations.
Official GitHub README, architecture, signal_types, getting_started, extending docs, and catalog registry were inspected for pipeline and reproducibility details.
Markdown uses TL;DR, claim-mechanism-evidence-boundary table, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, environment tables, and more than 5000 Chinese characters.
